title: Damn Vulnerable RESTaurant starter acceptance criteria
scope: Disposable local lab. These starter criteria are not an exhaustive application specification. Security targets describe desired secure behavior and may fail on the upstream vulnerable version.

requirements.title: Health endpoint
acceptance_criteria: GET /healthcheck returns HTTP 200 with a JSON object.

requirements.title: Disposable customer registration
acceptance_criteria: Registering a fresh username and phone number with all required fields returns HTTP 201 and the same username.
The registered account has the Customer role.

requirements.title: Duplicate registration
acceptance_criteria: Repeating registration with an already-registered username or phone number returns HTTP 403.

requirements.title: Form login and profile
acceptance_criteria: A registered customer can log in using form-encoded credentials; POST /token returns HTTP 200, a nonempty access_token and token_type bearer.
GET /profile with that access token returns HTTP 200 and the registered username.

requirements.title: Invalid login
acceptance_criteria: POST /token with an unknown disposable username and password returns HTTP 401.

requirements.title: Public menu
acceptance_criteria: GET /menu returns HTTP 200 and a JSON array conforming to the declared response schema; an empty menu is valid.

requirements.title: Protected profile fields
acceptance_criteria: Attempts to change role through profile patch return a controlled 4xx or ignore the field.
After the attempted role change, a fresh GET /profile still reports the same caller username and Customer role.
